title: Energy Predictor Configuration
description: Configure battery, solar arrays, and mechanical generators for energy prediction

minSafeSoC.title: Minimum Safe SoC
minSafeSoC.description: Minimum safe state of charge (0-1, where 1 is full)

chemistry.title: Battery Chemistry
chemistry.description: Battery chemistry. Sets the critical-SoC threshold for the 24h energy outlook status: LiFePO4 30%, lead-acid 45%

socPath.title: SoC Path
socPath.description: Signal K path for battery state of charge

engines.title: Propulsion Engines
engines.description: Propulsion engines (0+; monohulls usually one, catamarans often port + starboard). The engine is a high-reluctance deployable generator: recommended only when a sustained deficit leaves no renewable recovery path. Engine IDs are Signal K propulsion instance names — use whatever your vessel has (main, port, starboard, …)

alternatorWatts.title: Alternator Output
alternatorWatts.description: Expected alternator output when this engine runs (watts). 0 for electric drives or engines without an alternator — they are consumers and never recommended as generators

gensets.title: Gensets
gensets.description: Dedicated generators (diesel/DC generator, fuel cell). Most boats have none. A genset is the designated charger: it deploys before the main engine (night runs and at-anchor charging are unremarkable for it), still behind renewables

statePath.title: State Path
statePath.description: Signal K path for the genset state (e.g., electrical.generators.0.state). Values matching 'On Values' mean running

onValues.title: On Values
onValues.description: Comma-separated state values meaning running (default: started,on,online,running,active)

powerPath.title: Power Path
powerPath.description: Signal K path for the genset power output (watts). Positive output means running; used when no state path is set

combustion.title: Combustion Run Discipline
combustion.description: How reluctantly the genset and the main engine are recommended as generators (#11). Deficit escalates renewables → genset → engine; each tier deploys only on a sustained violation, runs a useful batch, then cools down

sustainedHours.title: Sustained Violation Hours
sustainedHours.description: Recommend a run only when the projected SoC stays below the minimum safe floor for at least this many consecutive hours (a bank already below the floor deploys immediately)

minRunMinutes.title: Minimum Run
minRunMinutes.description: Shortest useful run in minutes — never start the source for less (engines dislike short cold runs)

cooldownHours.title: Cooldown
cooldownHours.description: After a detected run ends, suppress new run recommendations for this many hours (engines dislike frequent cold starts)

socMargin.title: Batch SoC Margin
socMargin.description: Run until SoC reaches floor + this margin (fraction) — finish the batch, don't stop the moment the floor is cleared

nightHold.title: Hold at Night
nightHold.description: At night, prefer waiting for the morning solar window when the SoC floor isn't breached before sunrise (a bank already below the floor still deploys immediately)

sustainedHours.title: Sustained Violation Hours
sustainedHours.description: Recommend a run only when the projected SoC stays below the minimum safe floor for at least this many consecutive hours (a bank already below the floor deploys immediately)

minRunMinutes.title: Minimum Run
minRunMinutes.description: Shortest useful run in minutes — never start the source for less (engines dislike short cold runs)

cooldownHours.title: Cooldown
cooldownHours.description: After a detected run ends, suppress new run recommendations for this many hours (engines dislike frequent cold starts)

socMargin.title: Batch SoC Margin
socMargin.description: Run until SoC reaches floor + this margin (fraction) — finish the batch, don't stop the moment the floor is cleared

nightHold.title: Hold at Night
nightHold.description: At night, prefer waiting for the morning solar window when the SoC floor isn't breached before sunrise (a bank already below the floor still deploys immediately)

solarArrays.title: Solar Arrays
solarArrays.description: Configure your solar panels and deployable arrays

type.title: Array Type
type.description: Fixed panels or deployable sail-like array

powerPath.title: Power Path
powerPath.description: Signal K path for power output reading (watts)

controllerModePath.title: Controller Mode Path
controllerModePath.description: Signal K path for charge controller mode (optional, for sanitization)

deployStatePath.title: Deploy State Path
deployStatePath.description: Signal K path for current deploy/stow state (optional). Used to detect if change is needed.

gustLimitKnots.title: Gust Limit
gustLimitKnots.description: Wind gust threshold for stowing deployable arrays (knots)

gustHysteresisKnots.title: Gust Hysteresis
gustHysteresisKnots.description: Redeploy only after gusts drop this far below the limit (knots)

reluctance.title: Reluctance to deploy
reluctance.description: How willing the crew is to deploy/stow this source. Low: deploy even for an hour of output. Medium: deploy when a couple hours of output are available. High: deploy only when you can get most of a day of output. Leave blank to use the type default (FLINsail arrays are typically Medium).

enumNames.low: Low — deploy even for an hour of output
enumNames.medium: Medium — deploy for a couple hours of output
enumNames.high: High — deploy only for most of a day of output

hardwareEpochs.title: Hardware Epochs
hardwareEpochs.description: Periods when this array was active with different capacity

capacityWp.title: Current Capacity
capacityWp.description: Current peak wattage of the array

deployable.title: Deployable
deployable.description: Generator can be deployed/retracted (hydrogenerators are typically deployable)

deployableAtMoored.title: Deployable at mooring
deployableAtMoored.description: Whether this wind generator can be deployed while moored (some vessels cannot due to proximity to dock or other boats). When false, the generator is predicted stowed at moored and only deployed at anchor.

reluctance.title: Reluctance to deploy
reluctance.description: How willing the crew is to deploy/stow this generator. Low: deploy even for an hour of output. Medium: deploy when a couple hours of output are available. High: deploy only when you can get most of a day of output. Leave blank to use the type default (hydro generators are typically Low; wind generators typically High).

enumNames.low: Low — deploy even for an hour of output
enumNames.medium: Medium — deploy for a couple hours of output
enumNames.high: High — deploy only for most of a day of output

flipCooldownHours.title: Flip cooldown (hours)
flipCooldownHours.description: How long after a deploy/stow recommendation the opposite recommendation is held (published as a delta but not notified) — the hysteresis band that stops a marginal wind generator from deploy/stow cycling on every lull. Leave blank to use the reluctance default (Low 1h, Medium 2h, High 8h).

maxWindKnots.title: Max Wind Speed
maxWindKnots.description: Maximum safe wind speed (knots) - stow above this (wind generators only)

startupSpeedKnots.title: Startup Wind Speed
startupSpeedKnots.description: Minimum wind speed (knots) for the generator to produce power (wind generators only)

minSpeedKnots.title: Min Speed
minSpeedKnots.description: Minimum boat speed to start generating (knots) - hydro generators only

maxSpeedKnots.title: Max Speed
maxSpeedKnots.description: Maximum safe boat speed (knots) - stow above this (hydro generators only)

powerPath.title: Power Path
powerPath.description: Signal K path for power output reading (watts)

deployStatePath.title: Deploy State Path
deployStatePath.description: Signal K path for current deploy/stow state (optional). Used to detect if change is needed.

manufacturerCurve.title: Power Curve
manufacturerCurve.description: Comma-separated pairs of speed (knots) and power (watts), e.g., '5,10,10,50,20,100'

learning.title: Learning Configuration
learning.description: Machine learning parameters for efficiency profiling

enabled.title: Enable Learning
enabled.description: Continuously update efficiency matrices from actual output

saveIntervalMinutes.title: Save Interval
saveIntervalMinutes.description: How often to save learning matrices to disk (minutes)

minIntervalSeconds.title: Minimum Learning Interval
minIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum time between learning cycles (seconds). Solar power deltas arriving within the interval are accumulated into the running average

averageWindowSeconds.title: Power Averaging Window
averageWindowSeconds.description: Running-average window for solar power values fed to learning (seconds)

emaAlpha.title: EMA Smoothing Factor
emaAlpha.description: Exponential moving average alpha (lower = slower learning, higher = faster adaptation)

defaultEfficiency.title: Default Efficiency
defaultEfficiency.description: Starting efficiency for unlearned matrix bins (0.1-1.0)

preferredProvider.title: Preferred Provider
preferredProvider.description: Signal K Weather plugin ID to use (fallback to Open-Meteo if unavailable)

openMeteoEnabled.title: Enable Open-Meteo
openMeteoEnabled.description: Use Open-Meteo as direct NWP source when online

useLogbook.title: Use Logbook Fallback
useLogbook.description: Use signalk-logbook entries for cloud cover when no forecast available

forecastCacheHours.title: Offline Forecast Reuse (hours)
forecastCacheHours.description: How long a tier-1/tier-2 forecast (live or restored from disk) stays usable as the primary source before the FSM falls back to logbook oktas / clear-sky. Offshore with Internet once a day, keep this at 24h.

recording.title: Recording Configuration
recording.description: Store predictions and measured values for the timeline webapp

enabled.title: Enable Recording
enabled.description: Record prediction cycles and measured samples to disk

retentionDays.title: Retention Days
retentionDays.description: Number of days to keep recordings before pruning

windProtection.title: Wind Protection Factor
windProtection.description: Learn local wind shelter at anchor and marina: a place- and direction-local correction between measured and forecast wind, applied to FLINsail gust gates and wind generator predictions

enabled.title: Enable Wind Protection Learning
enabled.description: Learn a place-local wind correction factor while anchored or moored and apply it to wind-dependent predictions

learnGusts.title: Learn Gust Factor
learnGusts.description: Learn a gust factor (per place, direction, and day/night) in addition to the speed factor

emaAlpha.title: EMA Smoothing Factor
emaAlpha.description: Exponential moving average alpha for factor learning (lower = slower learning)

minForecastWindKnots.title: Minimum Forecast Wind
minForecastWindKnots.description: Discard learning samples when forecast wind is below this (ratios are noise in calm conditions), in knots

dwellMinutes.title: Dwell Time
dwellMinutes.description: Minimum time settled in a place before learning starts (excludes arrival maneuvers), in minutes

cellSizeM.title: Place Cell Size
cellSizeM.description: Size of the grid cell used as the place identity (approximate meters). Smaller = more precise but slower to converge

maxPlaces.title: Max Stored Places
maxPlaces.description: LRU cap on the number of places kept (favorite anchorages and the home marina converge quickly)

anemometerHeightM.title: Anemometer Height
anemometerHeightM.description: Anemometer height above waterline in meters (masthead). Leave 0 to read from design.airHeight

deviceHeightM.title: Device Height
deviceHeightM.description: Height of solar panels / wind generator above waterline, in meters. Corrected wind is translated down to this height before hitting gust gates and the wind gen curve

roughnessLength.title: Roughness Length (z₀)
roughnessLength.description: Log wind-profile roughness length in meters (0.0002 open water, 0.1 rough coast). Not observable per spot in v1

crossBinGustFallback.title: Cross Day/Night Gust Fallback
crossBinGustFallback.description: When a gust bin is unlearned, borrow from the same sector's other day/night bin (clamped to ≤ 1.0 so a borrowed daytime factor only ever reduces a night forecast, never inflates one). Off by default: katabatic night gusts can exceed 1.0 at places whose daytime gust factor is well below 1.0, so cross-bin borrowing can under-state real night risk

enabled.title: Enable Load Profile Learning
enabled.description: Learn sun-phase-based load patterns instead of using flat averages

alpha.title: EMA Alpha
alpha.description: Exponential moving average smoothing factor (lower = slower learning)

minDaysPerBin.title: Minimum Days per Bin
minDaysPerBin.description: Minimum number of distinct days a bin needs samples from before it's used for prediction

outlierFactor.title: Spike Gate Factor
outlierFactor.description: Samples above this factor × bin EMA are dropped as outliers

surplus.title: Surplus Energy Alerting
surplus.description: Notify when the battery is forecast full while yield continues, so the charge controller would curtail energy that could run opportunistic loads (watermaker, ice maker). Includes the motoring side-effect case (arriving by motor at midday with hours of sun left)

enabled.title: Enable Surplus Alerting
enabled.description: Publish a surplus-energy opportunity notification and Signal K value when the battery is forecast full with yield to spare

fullThreshold.title: Full Threshold
fullThreshold.description: SoC at which the bank is considered full (absorption/full), 0-1

minSurplusWh.title: Minimum Surplus (Wh)
minSurplusWh.description: Minimum wasted-potential energy required to trigger an alert. Below this the surplus is too small to act on

maxLeadHours.title: Max Lead Time (hours)
maxLeadHours.description: Only alert for surplus windows starting within this many hours. Beyond that, forecast uncertainty makes the alert noise

opportunisticLoads.title: Opportunistic Loads
opportunisticLoads.description: Loads that can usefully consume surplus energy. Shown as suggestions in the alert message. Advisory-only — no load switching

watts.title: Typical Power (W)
watts.description: Typical draw when running, used to estimate how long the surplus could run it

statePath.title: State Path (optional)
statePath.description: Signal K path indicating whether this load is already running. A boolean true (digital switching) or a string matching onValues means running; the load is then not suggested as a surplus use since it is already consuming power. Leave blank for loads that aren't instrumented

onValues.title: On Values (optional)
onValues.description: Comma-separated values at statePath that mean the load is running, e.g. 'online,started,on'. Defaults to 'started,on,online,running,active'

notification.title: Notification Urgency
notification.description: Multi-level notification urgency. Maps deploy/stow and battery advisories to Signal K notification states (alert/warn/alarm) and methods (visual/sound) based on intensity, time-to-action, event duration, and how confident we are about the detected deployment state. The urgency ladder (info→low→medium→high) is designed to prevent ever reaching alarm, which is reserved for vessel-safety-compromised situations (e.g. battery about to cut off nav lights/AIS/VHF)

urgency.title: Urgency Tuning
urgency.description: Override the urgency calculation knobs. Defaults are sensible for most vessels; leave a field blank to keep its default

thresholds.title: Urgency Thresholds
thresholds.description: Score boundaries mapping to each urgency level

batterySoCTiers.title: Battery SoC Tiers
batterySoCTiers.description: SoC fractions (0-1) at which each urgency level kicks in for engine/battery advisories

minGoodOutputHoursByType.title: Per-Deployable Reluctance (minimum good-output hours)
minGoodOutputHoursByType.description: Default minimum good-output hours to justify deploying each deployable type — the reluctance gate. A short forecast window caps a deploy suggestion at Low (visual, no sound). Hydro is Low (1h), FLINsail is Medium (2h), wind generators are High (8h). A per-device reluctance pulldown overrides these.
